title: The Psychologist Who Made Rats Kill Each Other for Fun
hook: In a classified 1960s experiment, a researcher turned lab rats into cannibals with a single sound frequency—and then tried it on humans.
why_this_can_go_viral: Animal cruelty and hidden experiments trigger outrage and morbid curiosity; the 'tried on humans' twist creates a powerful cliffhanger.

title: The Mass Psychology That Made a Stadium Riot Over a Silent Scream
hook: A single infrasound tone played during a soccer match made 30,000 people attack each other—without knowing why.
why_this_can_go_viral: Infrasound is a little-known phenomenon; the idea that a sound can hijack a crowd's emotions feels like a conspiracy theory that's true.

title: The Cognitive Bias That Made Parents Forget Their Own Babies
hook: A flaw in memory recall caused mothers to deny their children existed—even when the child was standing right in front of them.
why_this_can_go_viral: The thought of forgetting your own child is terrifying and deeply relatable; the twist that it's a cognitive bias makes it shareable.

title: The Propaganda System That Made a Country Worship a Traffic Light
hook: A totalitarian regime convinced millions that a blinking red light was a divine messenger—and anyone who looked away was arrested.
why_this_can_go_viral: Absurd yet terrifying—viewers will click to see how a mundane object became a symbol of fear and control.

title: The Social Engineer Who Hacked a Prison by Mimicking a Guard's Cough
hook: He recorded a guard's cough, played it back on a loop, and fooled the entire security system into opening every cell door.
why_this_can_go_viral: Simple yet brilliant—the idea that a cough can bypass security is absurd and fascinating, perfect for short-form video.

title: The Cognitive Bias That Made Doctors Ignore a Bleeding Patient—Because of His Suit
hook: A well-dressed man bled out in an ER because the halo effect made nurses assume he was healthy—and they looked away.
why_this_can_go_viral: High shock value and relatable (everyone judges by appearance); the medical setting adds urgency and credibility.

title: The Dark Persuasion Science That Made a City Curfew Itself—Out of Paranoia
hook: A single fake news broadcast about 'night predators' used emotional contagion to make an entire city lock itself indoors for a month.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relevant to modern misinformation panic; the self-imposed curfew angle feels like a real-life social experiment.

title: The Psychological Warfare That Made a General Desert His Army—Over a Song
hook: A hidden melody played at low frequency triggered a dissociative state in a decorated general, making him walk off the battlefield.
why_this_can_go_viral: Music as weapon is a compelling angle; the high-rank target makes the story feel epic and cinematic.

title: The Manipulation Tactic That Made a Village Destroy Its Own Crops—for a Promise of Gold
hook: A con artist used 'reciprocity' by giving away fake gold coins—then convinced farmers to burn their fields to 'unlock' more treasure.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reciprocity is a known principle, but the extreme destruction of livelihood makes it a shocking case study.

title: The Real Mind Control That Made a Woman Laugh Uncontrollably—While in Surgery
hook: A brain stimulation experiment triggered an uncontrollable laughing fit in a conscious patient—even as they cut into her skull.
why_this_can_go_viral: Genuinely unsettling—laughter during surgery is a visceral contradiction that sticks in memory.

title: The Mass Psychology That Made 1,000 People Believe They Were Invisible—After a Mass Hypnosis Show
hook: A stage hypnotist's suggestion made an entire audience walk into traffic—convinced no one could see them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Mass hypnosis is a fascinating and scary topic; the 'walked into traffic' detail raises the stakes dramatically.

title: The Social Engineer Who Stole a Country's Military Plan—by Asking for a Train Schedule
hook: He called a general's office pretending to be a railway clerk, extracted troop movements, and handed them to an enemy state.
why_this_can_go_viral: Classic social engineering story with a military twist; the simplicity of the method shocks viewers.

title: The Real Mind Control That Made a Patient Feel No Pain—Even While on Fire
hook: A self-hypnosis technique taught by a rogue psychologist allowed a man to walk through flames—until his body failed him.
why_this_can_go_viral: The visual of walking through flames is instantly gripping; the 'body failed him' twist adds a dark lesson.
